package com.acme.loyalty.model;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatNullPointerException;

import java.time.Instant;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class PointsTransactionTest {

    private static final Instant T0 = Instant.parse("2026-10-01T08:00:00Z");

    @Test
    void earn_alwaysStoresPositivePoints() {
        PointsTransaction tx = PointsTransaction.earn(5L, -300, "SPEND; store #12");

        assertThat(tx.points()).isEqualTo(300);
        assertThat(tx.memberId()).isEqualTo(5L);
        assertThat(tx.occurredAt()).isNotNull();
    }

    @Test
    void reversedNegatesPointsAndPrefixesReason() {
        PointsTransaction tx = new PointsTransaction(5L, 250, "BIRTHDAY", T0);

        PointsTransaction rev = tx.reversed();

        assertThat(rev.points()).isEqualTo(-250);
        assertThat(rev.reason()).isEqualTo("REVERSAL: BIRTHDAY");
        assertThat(rev.occurredAt()).isEqualTo(T0);
    }

    @Test
    void reasonIsMandatory() {
        assertThatNullPointerException()
                .isThrownBy(() -> new PointsTransaction(5L, 10, null, T0))
                .withMessage("reason");
    }
}
